newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indonesia's PT Enseval sets $100 mln revolver.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's PT Enseval sets $100 mln revolver.

text.p: The following syndicated loan issue was announced by the joint arrangers.
The borrower, PT Enseval, is the investment holding company of Indonesia's major manufacturer and distributor of pharmaceutical, healthcare and consumer products.
AMOUNT US$100 MLN TYPE REVOLVING CREDIT
STAND-BY L/C FEE 122.5bp PER ANNUM LAUNCH 13.JUN.97
REPAYMENT BULLET HOME CTRY INDONESIA REPLIES --
ARRANGERS CREDIT LYONNAIS'S SINGAPORE BRANCH, DBS BANK,
CO-ARRANGERS DAI-ICHI KANGYO BANK, OCBC BANK AND SAKURA BANK.
PUT WAIVER FEE OF 0.25 PCT FLAT
COMMITMENT FEE OF 0.1875 PCT PER ANNUM
